visualCharacteristics.purpose: applies the Cinematic motion register to the page: hero drift and rise, scroll reveals, image settle

contentPattern.structure: an empty block table (one cell, may be left blank)

usage: Once per page, in the same section as the hero, directly after it.
reuseGuidance: Has no content. Motion is off for visitors who prefer reduced motion and never applies to the header, footer, logos or primary buttons.
